atomic_add_double.compiler_refusal_acquire_release: MSL rejects memory_order_acquire and memory_order_release verbatim: 'use of undeclared identifier memory_order_acquire'. Fenced atomic_exchange_explicit + atomic_thread_fence(mem_device, memory_order_seq_cst) is mandatory on Apple Metal.
